case_name: Text on screen in a clip
title: Mountain Morning Opening Title
tests: Checks exact, legible title-card text, its opening placement and duration, and the transition into moving scenery.

faults.what: The title card is still fully visible at 2.3 seconds rather than cutting to the lake at about 2 seconds, shortening the requested lake sequence.

judge.summary: The correct title and attractive moving sunrise lake scene are present, but the title card lasts too long.

must_haves.item: The opening title reads exactly 'A quieter kind of morning', with no quotation marks or extra text.
must_haves.why: The title matches exactly, and no other text is visible.

must_haves.item: The title is legible cream lettering on a dark green card, fully inside the frame.
must_haves.why: The cream title is clearly readable and comfortably contained within the dark green frame.

must_haves.item: The title card occupies approximately the first 2 seconds, then cuts to the lake scene.
must_haves.why: The frame at 2.3 seconds still shows the complete title card; the lake appears by 3.8 seconds, so the transition occurs late.

must_haves.item: The remaining scene shows a misty mountain lake at sunrise with visible slow camera or scene motion.
must_haves.why: The lake has mountain reflections, drifting mist, and warm sunrise light; the framing and mist change between the two lake frames.

must_haves.item: The delivered video is silent, 16:9 and approximately 6 seconds long.
must_haves.why: The supplied duration is 6 seconds and the frames are 16:9. The reported peak of -91 dB is effectively silent, despite the conflicting speech transcription.
